issue_rules.title: Use restriction is missing or weak
issue_rules.explanation_template: The agreement does not clearly limit use of Confidential Information to the stated evaluation purpose.
issue_rules.comment_template: Add a purpose-limited use restriction tied to the transaction evaluation.
issue_rules.fallback_language: Recipient may use Confidential Information solely to evaluate and negotiate the contemplated transaction and for no other purpose.

issue_rules.title: Residuals carve-out is present
issue_rules.explanation_template: The agreement includes a residuals or unaided-memory carve-out that may undercut confidentiality protection.
issue_rules.comment_template: Review whether the residuals carve-out should be deleted or narrowed.

issue_rules.title: Compelled disclosure process is missing
issue_rules.explanation_template: The agreement does not appear to require notice and cooperation before compelled disclosure.
issue_rules.comment_template: Add notice and protective-order cooperation language for compelled disclosure.
issue_rules.fallback_language: If Recipient is required by law to disclose Confidential Information, Recipient will, to the extent legally permitted, give prompt notice and reasonably cooperate in seeking confidential treatment or a protective order.

issue_rules.title: Return or destruction obligation is missing
issue_rules.explanation_template: The agreement does not clearly require return or destruction of Confidential Information and copies.
issue_rules.comment_template: Add a return/destroy obligation at the disclosing party's request or on termination of discussions.
issue_rules.fallback_language: Upon Discloser's request, Recipient will promptly return or destroy Confidential Information and all copies, except for automatically created backup copies retained under standard security procedures.

issue_rules.title: Confidentiality survival period is missing
issue_rules.explanation_template: The agreement does not clearly state how long confidentiality obligations survive.
issue_rules.comment_template: Add an express survival period for confidentiality obligations.

issue_rules.title: Assignment restriction is present
issue_rules.explanation_template: The agreement includes an assignment or change-of-control restriction that should be checked for affiliate or reorganization carve-outs.
issue_rules.comment_template: Consider adding a carve-out for internal reorganizations or affiliate assignments.
